data.name: Saumitra
data.gender_notes: Saumitra is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Saumitra is recorded with the meaning “Friend of the Moon”. Saumitra is a Sanskrit name meaning “Friend of the Moon”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Saumitra expresses “Friend of the Moon”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: सौमित्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is a friend of Soma, the moon god. A name of Lakshmana, brother of Lord Rama.

in_hindi.name: सौमित्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: सोम के मित्र होने वाला, सोम देव का नाम है। रामायण में लक्ष्मण का एक नाम है।

in_tamil.name: சௌமித்ரன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: சொமன் தேவனுக்கு அருளாளன், இந்த பெயர் ராமாயணத்தில் லக்ஷ்மணனுக்கு வழிவகையாக இருக்கிறது.

in_telugu.name: సౌమిత్ర
in_telugu.long_meaning: సోమ దేవుడ్ కు మిత్రం ఉంది. ఆ పేరు రామాయణంలో లక్ష్మణ పేరు కూడా ఉంది.

in_marathi.name: Saumitra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Friend of the Moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saumitra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from two words, 'Soma' meaning moon and 'Mitra' meaning friend.

in_bengali.name: Saumitra
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Friend of the Moon
in_bengali.long_meaning: Saumitra একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from two words, 'Soma' meaning moon and 'Mitra' meaning friend.
